entries.name: First Days in Blockwild
entries.summary: A practical route from a new world to a safe, equipped explorer without prescribing one correct play style.

sections.heading: A useful opening
paragraphs: Gather nearby wood and stone, make a basic tool set, and establish a lit shelter before ranging farther.
Food, a bed, spare blocks, and a marked return route make exploration much safer than raw combat power alone.

sections.heading: Then choose a direction
paragraphs: Follow roads and rivers toward settlements, study a local creature, begin a farm, descend into a supported cave, or prepare for multiplayer.

entries.name: Crafting, Stations, and Machines
entries.summary: One linked production language connects hand recipes, shaped crafting, furnaces, mills, alchemy, distilling, and faction machines.

sections.heading: Find any material
paragraphs: Press ? while an item is selected to open its exact wiki page. Origins, recipes, stations, and downstream uses are drawn from the same live registries used by the game.

sections.heading: Blueprints
paragraphs: Some advanced designs require a learned blueprint. The item page names that requirement instead of hiding it in a separate recipe list.

entries.name: Capture and Bonding
entries.summary: Capture establishes safe custody; trust and companionship are earned through a separate, visible care path.

sections.heading: Capture readiness
paragraphs: Passive creatures must be calm. Aggressive creatures always retain the reliable health-threshold route, with visible non-damage alternatives when their behavior supports them.
Aquatic targets must share the correct water medium, but do not need a special orb.

sections.heading: From custody to companionship
paragraphs: Eligible specimens move through Stabilize, Nourish, Connect, and Form Bond at Creature Camp. Only the final bond grants ownership and companion use.

sections.heading: Exceptions
paragraphs: People, commissioned constructs, covenant creatures, faction-aligned specimens, and authored summons report their own recruitment or attunement path rather than silently failing.

entries.name: Bestiary Research
entries.summary: The Bestiary records what your character has personally learned; this wiki explains the stable public rules around it.

sections.heading: Progressive notes
paragraphs: Seeing, defeating, capturing, taming, breeding, and authored milestones can reveal later field notes. Complex creatures such as dragons can therefore grow across many discoveries without changing the save schema.

sections.heading: Public knowledge versus character knowledge
paragraphs: The wiki describes general ecology and systems. Locked Bestiary text, variants, and mastery remain character progression and are not bypassed here.

entries.name: Farming and Flora
entries.summary: Wild plants, tended crops, orchards, aquatic cultivation, and processing stations form one renewable resource layer.

sections.heading: Cultivation
paragraphs: Plant pages record the appropriate habitat, growth rule, and known yield. Mature crops can be harvested in place where their field behavior supports it.

sections.heading: Ecology
paragraphs: Not every useful plant belongs in a farm. Trees, wetland plants, ocean staples, fungi, and rare ecological-center flora remain tied to exploration.

entries.name: Exploration, Maps, and Travel
entries.summary: Maps remember explored terrain, discoveries, custom pins, waystones, and the routes that make an endless world legible.

sections.heading: Wayfinding
paragraphs: Use the compass for heading and nearby discoveries, the map for terrain and pins, and waystones for the fast-travel network.

sections.heading: World layers
paragraphs: The surface, oceans, dark connecting tunnels, ecological cavern centers, settlements, dungeons, and landmark POIs reward different preparation.

entries.name: The World Below
entries.summary: A connected cave world of dark stone roads, rare luminous ecologies, great caverns, settlements, hazards, and authored destinations.

sections.heading: Contrast matters
paragraphs: Ordinary tunnels remain dark. Bioluminescence concentrates in ecological centers so a living cavern feels discovered rather than becoming the default wallpaper.

sections.heading: Travel prepared
paragraphs: Bring light, food, markers, spare blocks, and vertical traversal tools. Large chambers can contain water, lava, flying life, rare resources, ruins, and routes to deeper bands.

entries.name: Shared Worlds
entries.summary: Direct multiplayer keeps one host authoritative over world state while each player brings a persistent browser-local character.

sections.heading: Authority
paragraphs: The host validates world edits, inventories, creature state, combat, containers, and other shared actions. Guests keep their personal identity while the shared world stays coherent.

sections.heading: Invites
paragraphs: Host or join from the Multiplayer menu with an invite code. Export important local worlds and characters as part of normal browser-save hygiene.

entries.name: Cardforge
entries.summary: A deterministic in-world card game built from Blockwild's creatures, factions, locations, and stories.

sections.heading: Creature identity
paragraphs: Standard creature cards use the canonical production model as their source of truth. Full Art printings may change staging and atmosphere, but not the creature's anatomy or identity.

sections.heading: Collection
paragraphs: Cards can be opened, collected, archived, traded, organized into decks, and played without generating art or rules text at runtime.

entries.name: Controls and Accessibility
entries.summary: Keyboard, mouse, touch, camera, audio, UI scale, and performance settings can be adjusted without changing world identity.

sections.heading: Useful shortcuts
paragraphs: Press ? for the selected item's wiki page. Use the pause menu for the complete current control list and accessibility settings.

sections.heading: Performance
paragraphs: Simulation, full render, and basic render distances are separate. Lower them independently when a device needs more headroom.
